en.title: Merit Award – Construction Safety
en.subtitle: Revolutionizing Construction Safety: A Multimodal LLM-Powered Robotic Dog for Proactive Hazard Prevention
en.body: Hong Kong's first multimodal LLM construction safety robot can autonomously patrol construction sites and capture 360-degree immersive panoramic views of high-risk areas.
en.imageAlt: Merit Award for Construction Safety — Vibro (H.K.) Ltd. multimodal LLM-powered robotic dog for proactive hazard prevention on construction sites

zh.title: 優異獎 – 建造安全
zh.subtitle: 革新建造安全：多模態 LLM 驅動的機器人犬實現主動危害預防
zh.body: 香港首個多模態 LLM 建造安全機器人可自主巡邏工地，並捕捉高風險區域的 360 度沉浸式全景視野。
zh.imageAlt: 建造安全優異獎 — Vibro (H.K.) Ltd. 多模態 LLM 驅動的機器人犬，用於工地主動危害預防
